name: Text Easability components
reference_corpus: Reference corpus A, English (easability/REFERENCE_PLAN_EN.md): 9 registers x 1,000 passages of 250-350 words cut by TASA_de's rule with English settings (news report, personal narrative, encyclopedia, informational description, research and expert, how-to, opinion/review/advice, persuasion/commercial from FineWeb sample-10BT, wiki40b, Wikinews and Intereconomics; fiction 1900-1918 from PG-19); Coh-Metrix 0.6.0-dev: 0.5.0-py with three definitions of TTLab's duui-coh-metrix 0.6.0 (SYNNP: the words whose head is the noun phrase's head; LSAGN / LSAGNd: the first sentence as 0; German SMTEMP: the Konjunktiv as TMV) and SUBTLEX-DE's full list (README "Version 0.6.0-dev"; snapshot code_20261104_v060dev)
method: PCA on standardized inputs (missing values: reference mean), Varimax rotation; z = standardized inputs @ weights; percentile = share of reference texts with a lower z; at runtime only inputs with missing_documents > 0 may be missing (reference mean), otherwise the components are undefined; one measure of each pair with |r| > .90 removed before the PCA; components named and oriented by Tucker's congruence with the reference model /data/CORE/export/t0/coh_metrix/easability/refv1_ud_rr_cr4/loadings.csv

inputs.measure: Words before main verb of main clause
Dissimilarity of parts of speech between sentences
